checks: 503 then success makes exactly two attempts and rechecks the original gate before the second send
Transient HTTP500 is capped at two retries, three total attempts
Auth, balance, invalid parameters and long rate windows stay one-shot and have distinct public categories
Ambiguous transport failure is never replayed and raw error text never enters diagnostics
Stop cancels an actual three-second retry wait within 300ms and dispatches no later attempt
An accepted response whose body later breaks is not retried as a fresh whole response
Projection preserves per-attempt retry history, bounds it at 64 and settles waiting rows on interruption
Partial output and finished tools prepare continuation with original constraints; a pre-effect failure can restore the original editable prompt
Broken trailing commentary becomes a visible partial answer; pre-tool narration remains process text
Optional typed task continuation admits valid task/version only, preserves legacy input and rejects unknown/accessor fields
Attachment admission includes the same bound-task intent digest as host while legacy hash remains unchanged
boundary: Actual HTTP recovery adapter, public projection and editable continuation policy; synthetic local fetch responses, no provider/UI/full AT claim.
